candidates.rationale: The source returns a mutable reference into RefCell storage. A useful contract must model both the hidden contained value and write-back through the returned reference; current vstd has no suitable RefCell view or supported mutable-reference result relation.

The implementation reinterprets the same storage as UnsafeCell<T>. Its essential guarantee is mutable-reference identity and aliasing, which cannot be expressed usefully with a value-only view in current vstd.

The source returns a mutable reference directly to the wrapped storage. Expressing subsequent write-back requires an UnsafeCell value model and supported mutable-reference result semantics, neither of which is available.

The implementation may advance the underlying iterator to populate hidden cached state, then returns a mutable reference into that cache. Current vstd lacks the general iterator/cache abstraction and mutable-reference relation needed for a useful contract.

The source initializes the storage with val and returns a mutable reference to that exact storage. A useful contract requires initialized-state and write-back modeling for MaybeUninit plus supported mutable-reference results.

The source preserves the Option shape while applying arbitrary DerefMut behavior and returning its mutable target reference. Current vstd lacks a general DerefMut target relation and supported mutable-reference output modeling.
